text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm taking a walk along the
river, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: HEEEEEY! GET BACK HERE!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
YOU CAN'T RUN, MCQUEEN! I KNOW
WHAT
YOU'VE DONE!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ugh! Is she going to chase me all day?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Hey! Admit it! Admit to your crimes!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: N-never! I didn't do anything!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Is that how it's going to be? Then I'll do
it for you!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You sneakily finished off all the cake!
Even
though you're supposed to be on a
diet!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Agh! No! Please, say no more!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Look, I'm not a monster. I won't rat you out to your trainer. However...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
There is one thing you need to know...
You
listening?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Salmon! You must learn from and live by
the
salmon!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
...See, the thing about salmon is they
spend their
lives swimming upstream.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Now, that doesn't make sense to us,
does it? I
mean, why tire yourself out
like that?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But the salmon still do it... And do you
know
why?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Uhh... no? What are you on about,
anyway?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The salmon see adversity as opportunity!
A
chance to grow and realize their
potential!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
So, swim upstream! Just like the salmon!
BE the
salmon!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
So you ate the last of the cake—fine! But
you
should use this chance to work on
yourself!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Wait...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Time to burn that cake's calories... No,
make that
two cakes' worth! Then you're
on your way to
being an incredible
runner!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes, you're right!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I am merely a student of the salmon
myself. I still
have yet to reach their
level of zen.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
However, one day it will happen! I shall
face
adversity as the salmon do and
become a mighty
Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
To that end, I run! Until that day when
my dreams
finally come true...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип... I finally understand what
you're
trying to say!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume should always keep their
fighting
passion... and they should
always view challenges
as opportunities!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Which is why I'll use these calories to
run, and—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Oh! I think I see Flash over there!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
HALT! TODAY'S THE DAY I FINALLY
EAT MORE
SAUSAGES THAN YOUUU!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Wha—hey! Голд Шип?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Well, I see what fighting passion
looks like
now, but you must learn to
remain calm!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
